itens.titulo: Reflecting On Diversified Banks Stocks’ Q3 Earnings: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC)
itens.descricao: Reflecting On Diversified Banks Stocks’ Q3 Earnings: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) Yahoo Finance
trechos: The 7 diversified banks stocks we track reported a slower Q3.
As a group, revenues missed analysts' consensus estimates by 0.7%.
On average, share prices are down 1.8% since the latest earnings results.
Bank of America reported revenues of $30.1 billion, up 3.1% year on year.
This print fell short of analysts' expectations by 1.5%.
The market seems disappointed with the results as the stock is down 6.6% since reporting and currently trades at $50.41.

itens.titulo: JPMorgan Asset Sees Bitcoin Beating Stocks, But With a Catch
itens.descricao: JPMorgan Asset Sees Bitcoin Beating Stocks, But With a Catch Yahoo Finance
trechos: JPMorgan's base case projects annualized returns of 10% over the next decade, but also assumes annual volatility of 55%, more than three times that of US large-cap stocks.
That's a risk familiar to Bitcoin ETF investors who bought near the cryptocurrency's peak of just over $126,000 in 2025, only to see their holdings lose as much as 50% as prices retreated.
"We believe it is premature to consider BTC as a diversifier in a balanced portfolio," the JPMorgan team including Tim Lintern, Thushka Maharaj and Sean Daly wrote.
Still, Bitcoin right now doesn't cut it as a diversifier in balance portfolios due to its "unstable correlations" to other assets, the bank's researchers said.
"If correlations stabilize and volatility declines, BTC's portfolio utility may improve in the future," they wrote.
